decisions.reason: The request for a revised BOM does not change the system layout, CAD deliverable, or selected design direction.
The source requests a revised BOM but does not modify the wiring-plan deliverable or its electrical requirements.
Revising the BOM to reflect agreed changes does not itself alter the existing V1 sourcing policy or rapid-prototype priority.
Although the revised BOM may document the selected whisk, the source does not change any whisk configuration, attachment, positioning, or cleaning requirement.
The revised-BOM request does not change the spout's geometry, orientation, construction, appearance, or beverage-quality constraints.
